title: moosaic - Agent Guidelines
text: Automated data extraction, deconvolution, spectral searching GC-FID/MS data: FID-guided windowed MCR-ALS deconvolution, library search, RI/element-filtered identification, Polyarc quantification, reporting. Package: moosaic v0.0.0.9000 Authors: Philip Bulsink philip.bulsink@nrcan-rncan.gc.ca (aut, cre) License: GPL (>= 3)

title: moosaic - Agent Guidelines
text: Automated data extraction, deconvolution, spectral searching GC-FID/MS data. pipeline : read_experiment() → align_detectors() → FID peak/window detection → per-window rank estimation → FID-derived constraints → MCR-ALS fit (fit_window()) → components → library search (mspepsearchr) → RI + element-penalty scoring → Polyarc quantification (quantify()) → reports (summarize_report(), write_excel_report(), write_pdf_report()). one-call entry point process_sample(). .posit/SPEC.md authoritative design document (draft v2): conventions, per-stage file/function tables, testing strategy, options reference, decisions log. Read implementing modifying stage.

title: moosaic - Agent Guidelines
text: Read .posit/SPEC.md first: defines stage’s file/function table, data structures, options, decisions log (section 19). Read roxygen documentation R/*.R understand function purposes signatures; every function (including internal) full roxygen. Trace data flow pipeline stages (process_sample() reference order); identify files affected proposed change.

title: moosaic - Agent Guidelines
text: One function per file: R/{function_name}.R; internal helpers dot-prefixed file named without dot (e.g. .estimate_delay() → R/estimate_delay.R). create new .R files unless adding completely new capability fit existing module. Use .moosaic_abort(), .moosaic_warn(), .moosaic_inform() errors/warnings/messages (never bare stop()/warning()); pass class = "{name}" producing classes like moosaic-error-{class}, name calling function {.fn} messages. Validate parameters used; propagate call = rlang::caller_env(). Follow existing style: |> pipes, \() lambdas, tibbles tabular output, ASCII . Format air format . keep code lintr-clean. Preserve full roxygen every function touch (@param, @return structure, @details; @examples exported; @keywords internal helpers).

title: moosaic - Agent Guidelines
text: Tests written implementation mirror source files: create update tests/testthat/test-{name}.R matching R/{name}.R. Place new tests adjacent existing tests function. Test descriptions plain behavioural sentences issue labels (e.g. test_that(".bin_mz() rounds 39.9 bin 40", ...)). Use withr::local_options() around test changes moosaic options; use make_synthetic_run() helper-synthetic.R stage-level tests known truth, inline minimal inputs unit tests. Follow four-level gate: unit (per function) → stage (synthetic composition recovers ground truth) → challenge (real-data fixtures tests/testthat/fixtures/, guarded skip_if_not(file.exists(...))) → integration (test-integration-*.R). Log unexpected real-data behaviour dev/challenges.md. Run tests devtools::test() (testthat::test_local()); testthat edition 3 configured. functionality requires suggested packages: library search needs mspepsearchr (guarded requireNamespace(); Windows-executable) PDF reports need quarto — use skip_if_not_installed("quarto") tests optional features.

title: moosaic - Agent Guidelines
text: Regenerate man pages NAMESPACE: roxygen2::roxygenise() (devtools::document()). Never edit NAMESPACE man/*.Rd hand — generated roxygen comments. Update .posit/SPEC.md change alters stage’s contract, options table, data structures; record decisions log (section 19).

title: moosaic - Agent Guidelines
text: Full package check: devtools::check() (R CMD CHECK) — errors, warnings, notes. Review test coverage edited files covr; project target 100% per file, excluding R/moosaic-package.R R/aaa-*.R. Ensure regressions existing tests file references remain valid.

title: moosaic - Agent Guidelines
text: TDD: unit tests written implementation every function; stage done gate sequence (unit → stage → challenge) passes failure logged dev/challenges.md. Test outputs behaviour, just function existence: exact values hand-built inputs, error classes (moosaic-error-{class}), edge cases, ground-truth recovery synthetic runs. Synthetic data known truth via make_synthetic_run() mirrors real sampling rates (FID 50 Hz, MS 0.27 s scans) stage tests exercise realistic conditions cheaply. Real-data fixtures (fixtures/real_run/, fixtures/ri/ONSITE.CAL) small excerpts; large raw files never committed. Challenge/integration tests real data skip fixtures optional packages absent. Snapshots (_snaps/) pin stable outputs (e.g. MSP text, print methods); update deliberately testthat::snapshot_accept() output change intended. Failing tests valuable — address failures rather suppressing ; weaken assertions make stage pass. Local testing takes 36 minutes. Running devtools::check(cran=TRUE) skips long tests. Alternatively use testthat::local_on_cran();devtools::test(); withr::deferred_run(), filter testthat options passable devtools::test().
